result.description: The Orchid Arcadia 14L Countertop Composter is a compact kitchen appliance designed to convert food scraps into dry, odor-reduced compost material for home gardening. It features a sealed carbon filter lid, whisper-quiet thermal drying, and a removable inner bucket for easy cleaning. Ideal for apartments and small households, it operates on standard household power and helps reduce weekly waste volume without requiring outdoor space.
